name: Promote the Winner
description: Moves a project to its best implementation on evidence, with the proof attached, and stops short of the switch when a person must approve it.
purpose: Switch the selection to the rival that clearly wins on the solution's own metric, with the evidence recorded, or propose it when a person must approve.
approach: Switch the selection only on current, comparable, verified results beyond the noise, and otherwise propose the exact change.
out_of_scope: Deciding what is best; promoting on stale or incomparable results.
milestones: 1. Promotion correctness: a winner is promoted only on current, comparable, verified results beyond the noise, and the exact proposal is printed otherwise. [met: 2026-10-26]
knowledge: Model registry promotion gates; the leaderboard's same-cases comparison and noise margins.
measures_of_success: A switch happens only on current, comparable, verified results beyond the noise and only where the solution allows it; otherwise the exact proposal is printed. Standing conditions: A clear winner becomes the selected implementation without hand editing, and every switch carries its evidence.
parameters: A solution id (optional) and a dry run.
inputs: The results log, the records, and the `promotion` cell of each solution.
outputs: Edits to selected, selected_by and the metric's command, or a printed proposal.
effects: Rewrites the solution and metric rows and rebuilds the review tracker.
usage_notes: Put `automatic` in a solution's `promotion` cell where its policy lets the metric decide; leave it empty to review each proposal.
